items.title: fix(plugins): plugin session actions, hooks, and subagent-end notific…
items.summary: fix(plugins): plugin session actions, hooks, and subagent-end notifications fail during a plugin reload (#182310) * fix(plugins): wait out a plugin reload instead of failing calls during the swap Fresh host calls refused by a quiesced plugin instance with a pending replacement now wait for the reload to settle and resolve once more against the current registry: plugins.sessionAction, typed hook dispatch, and context-engine onSubagentEnded. A second refusal surfaces as retryable UNAVAILABLE (reason plugin-reloading). Memory provider calls admitted before quiesce no longer fail when they complete after it. Refs #182024 * fix(plugins): rerun hook admission and context for replacement handlers A hook dispatch that waits out a plugin reload now returns to its own loop before invoking the replacement registration, so claiming-hook binding admission is prepared and checked again, session_end transcript context is projected for the registration actually invoked, and a dispatch whose timeout expired during the wait starts no late replacement handler. * fix(plugins): ship reservation module with PR wrapper and prove binding admission across reload Add plugin-instance-replacement.ts to the trusted PR wrapper inventory, use respondError for the plugin-reloading response, and prove through the real conversation-binding owner that a binding reassigned or revoked during a plugin reload rejects before the replacement receives the inbound claim.

items.title: perf(gateway): renew publication leases off the main thread (#183596)
items.summary: perf(gateway): renew publication leases off the main thread (#183596) Route personal GitHub profile and workspace publication lease renewals through the existing heartbeat worker while preserving durable ownership checks at effects. Native bootstrap acquisition and heartbeat startup fallback remain unchanged. Add a real-owner concurrent-write regression and repair scoped profiler imports for frozen build comparisons. Full ten-minute AB/BA timing and allocation stress completed without a demonstrated regression; exact-head CI and independent review passed. No SQLite schema, checkpoint, journal, or durability policy changes.
